$comment: Icon system config, the single place icon style/weight/set is decided. Change a value here and run `npm run icons` to regenerate the font + glyph map, the same way design/tokens.json drives the type system. Material Symbols, rendered as a FONT rather than SVG (banned here — react-native-svg kills touch inside Reanimated views) or hand-drawn geometry (the old Icon.tsx, whose fixed shapes gave us the empty-box `bubble` and the smile-arc `phone`).
$style: rounded | outlined | sharp. Amit's call: switched rounded -> outlined to match the Mengobrol reference (thin, neutral outlined icons over the grotesk type). Changing this re-instances a different Material Symbols family on the next `npm run icons:font`.
$weight: 100-700. Material's default is 400. React Native Android cannot animate a variable-font axis at runtime, so weight is baked into the static instance at generation time, not set per-render.
$opticalSize: 20-48dp. The axis Material tunes stroke contrast on; 24 is the UI default and matches our default render size.
$fillOnActive: Ship TWO static instances — FILL 0 (outlined, the norm) and FILL 1 (filled, the active/selected state) — because RN Android cannot cross-fade the FILL axis live. The Icon renders the filled family when `active`. This is Material's own selection pattern and replaces the app's colour-only active signal with a shape signal too, which also helps colour-blind users.

glyphs.$comment: semantic name in the app  ->  Material Symbols glyph name. Add a row here, run `npm run icons`, use <Icon name="...">. The generator fails if a name is not in the Material Symbols codepoints.
glyphs.speaker: volume_up
